title: Smart Data Models - CityJSON v2.0 - BuildingConstructiveElement
description: https://www.cityjson.org/schemas/2.0.2/cityobjects.schema.json#BuildingConstructiveElement. A structural element of a Building, e.g. a wall, floor slab, or column, modeled as its own City Object. Part of the Building family of City Objects. Typed attributes cross-referenced from the CityGML 3.0 Building module (schemas.opengis.net/citygml/), the data model CityJSON's own attributes are informally derived from.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'BuildingConstructiveElement'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

isStructuralElement.description: Property. Indicates whether the constructive element is essential from a structural point of view. A structural element cannot be omitted without collapsing of the construction. Examples are pylons and anchorages of bridges.

class.description: Property. Indicates the specific type of the BuildingConstructiveElement. Coded value, typically drawn from an OGC CityGML code list (not resolved to a closed enum in this pass).

function.description: Property. Specifies the intended purposes of the BuildingConstructiveElement. Coded value, typically drawn from an OGC CityGML code list (not resolved to a closed enum in this pass).

usage.description: Property. Specifies the actual uses of the BuildingConstructiveElement. Coded value, typically drawn from an OGC CityGML code list (not resolved to a closed enum in this pass).

genericAttributes.description: Property. Open StructuredValue for additional name/value attributes beyond the typed properties above, per CityGML 3.0's own formal generic-attribute extension mechanism (generics.xsd: CodeAttribute, StringAttribute, DoubleAttribute, IntAttribute, DateAttribute, UriAttribute, MeasureAttribute, GenericAttributeSet). Not schema-validated by this candidate; use the typed properties above where one exists.

geographicalExtent.description: Property. Bounding box of the City Object as [minx, miny, minz, maxx, maxy, maxz], per the source CityJSON schema's shared _AbstractCityObject.geographicalExtent.

parents.description: Relationship. IDs of the parent City Object(s) in the same dataset, per the source CityJSON schema's shared _AbstractCityObject.parents.

children.description: Relationship. IDs of the child City Object(s) in the same dataset, per the source CityJSON schema's shared _AbstractCityObject.children.

geometryLoD0.description: GeoProperty. Dereferenced GeoJSON geometry (MultiPoint, MultiLineString, MultiPolygon) for this BuildingConstructiveElement at major Level of Detail 0 (covers source `lod` values "0" and "0.0"-"0.3"), flattened from CityJSON's native shared-vertex-array + boundary-index representation. Optional; present only if the source CityJSON file provides a Geometry entry at this LoD for this object. Surface `semantics`, `material`, and `texture` are not carried into this GeoProperty -- only boundary coordinates. Note: this type also allows GeometryInstance (reused geometry templates) in the source schema; template-referenced geometry is not flattened into these GeoProperties in this pass.
